rule_or_requirement: Local candidates must finish the qualified line on at least as many matched cells as the selected control before a faster lap can justify advancement.
observable_information: At inference, four grayscale frames and pixel-only road, speed, and obstacle diagnostics; evaluator records finish, action, speed, road contact, and runtime.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Preserve frozen opening launch and fixed early pixel bend steering only; no added gas or braking.
expected_success_endpoint: Launch and early steering activate; bend brake and extra boost remain zero; no candidate-only nonfinish on consumed diagnostic cells.
falsifier: Zero steering activation, changed launch count, added gas/brake, candidate-only nonfinish, invalid action, or resource breach.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Compare exact ZIPs on already consumed tracks 1-3 by seeds 2900-2903; 12 matched diagnostic cells, 24 episodes, 2000 decisions each.
resource_and_risk_gate: Registered local Linux CPU profile, 2 CPUs and 2 GiB, 1800 seconds; no independent completion inference or external action.
